fees.description: Membership of $25. per month (inc. GST) to access these wholesale rates.
Standard Connection Fee. Actual charges passed through from your distributor may vary, see www.amber.com.au/fees for more information
Standard Disconnection Fee. Actual charges passed through from your distributor may vary, see www.amber.com.au/fees for more information
An $3 (inc. GST) fee applies if payment is dishonoured or reversed.
A $16 (inc. GST) fee applies if full payment has not been received by the invoice due date
A fee of 1% applies to payments made by credit or debit card

electricityContract.terms: All usage is charged at the same wholesale electricity costs that are charged to us. If your average bill total over a financial year exceeds the c/kWh maximum annual rate listed below ‘Peak consumption’, then we reduce your bill so that the total does not exceed the maximum rate. You are also protected by Amber’s quarterly price guarantee published on our website. Full terms and conditions at https://www.amber.com.au/terms

discounts.description: Welcome credit of $180 applied over 12 months. New residential customers only who are also customers of CommBank (CBA) in the Yello Gold segment and link their CBA credit card or bank account as Amber payment method. Customers are ineligible to receive any remaining credit months if they cancel their Amber account, switch their payment method to a non-CBA account, or their CBA card expires. Additional eligibility requirements apply, see Amber website.

electricityContract.variation: Prices are not fixed. All usage is charged at the same wholesale electricity costs that are charged to us. Prices are determined by a range of factors, including government rebates, network fees and wholesale market costs.

eligibility.information: Conditional offer to new residential customers (who are also customers of Commonwealth Bank of Australia) in Jemena's distribution region with a flat rate, TOU or demand tariff and controlled load. For illustrative purposes, tariff A100/A180 assumed. Feed-In Tariffs are only valid if applicable
